responsibility: Implements GCC’s selective scheduling and software-pipelining algorithm for RTL. It forms scheduling regions and fences, computes and ranks available expressions, performs code motion with speculation, substitution, renaming, and bookkeeping copies, fills parallel groups at scheduling boundaries, supports loop pipelining and rescheduling of generated code, and coordinates global initialization/finalization for the selective-scheduling subsystem. This is the core scheduling algorithm, distinct from the supporting IR and dump files.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file contains the core selective-scheduling algorithm and top-level execution over regions, including scheduling, pipelining, and global init/fini orchestration. The companion header gcc/sel-sched.h is only the narrow external interface that declares the main run entry point and skip helper.
